object Identifier = value;
object IntegerLiteral = 42;
object FloatLiteral = 1.25;
object StringLiteral = "cloth";
object CharacterLiteral = 'c';
object BooleanLiteral = true;
object NullLiteral = null;
object SuperValue = super;
object Thrown = throw Failure();
object Unary = -value;
object PrefixUpdate = ++value;
object PostfixUpdate = value++;
object Precedence = a + b * c;
object TypeTest = value is Thing?;
object CheckedCast = value as Thing[]?;
object NumericConversion = int64(value);
object IntegerConversion = uint32::wrap(value);
object Assignment = a = b = c;
object Member = value.Name;
object Meta = value::length;
object SafeMember = value?.Name;
object SafeMeta = value?::length;
object Coalesce = a ?? b ?? c;
object Asserted = value!;
object Call = target(1, value);
object ArrayLiteral = [1, value];
object ArrayConstruction = int32[:size];
object Index = values[index];
object Grouped = (a + b);
object PrimitiveParse = int32::parse("42");
object PostfixChain = value?.Child::length(1)[0]!.Name;
static object Constant = 1 + 2 * 3;
object AllBinaryOperators =
    a ?? b || c && d | e ^ f & g == h != i < j <= k > l >= m << n >> o + p - q * r / s % t;
object AllAssignmentOperators = a = b += c -= d *= e /= f %= g <<= h >>= i &= j |= k ^= l;
